items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I taught Bill Saxton, gave him saxophone lessons.

ctx.x: Yeah. They were all his friends. So it wasn’t as much that I worked with them. I taught them. I taught Bill Saxton, gave him saxophone lessons. Took Fish and put him in the band, René in the band. So I was dealing with a lot of young musicians, because René was a young musician, right there.
So by this time René is 17, 18, 19?
